Production environment and choices

- Python 3.12
- ffmpeg / ffprobe (video decode, sidechain mix, subtitle burn-in, H.264/AAC encode)
- espeak-ng 1.51 with the installed Mandarin voice `cmn` (offline narration synthesis)
- numpy and scipy (48 kHz narration assembly and resampling)
- Debian `fonts-wqy-zenhei` 0.9.45-8, extracted locally under `fonts/` for CJK subtitle rendering
- edge-tts 7.3.1 and its pip dependencies were installed for a neural voice attempt. Its service returned no audio through the configured proxy, so it was not used in the final render.

Run `bash /workspace/submission/render_final.sh` to regenerate narration.wav, subtitles.srt,
segments.json, and final.mp4. No video or original audio was sent to an external service.
